item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 10/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of southern China will moderate gradually, temperatures will rise over the region in the next couple of days. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong on Thursday, bringing a few rain patches to the region. It will be gradually replaced by a continental airstream in the following couple of days. The weather will be mainly fine over the coast of southern China during the weekend and early next week. Besides, an area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days.
